import polars as pl
import re
import datetime
import math

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    def parse_money(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
        s = raw[col_name].str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "").str.strip_chars()
        return s.cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)

    debit_clean = parse_money("Debit")
    credit_clean = parse_money("Credit")
    balance_clean = parse_money("Balance")

    amount_expr = (
        pl.when(credit_clean.is_not_null())
        .then(credit_clean)
        .otherwise(-debit_clean)
        .round(2)
    )

    return raw.select(
        account=pl.col("Account Number").str.strip_chars(),
        txn_date=pl.col("Transaction Date").str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        description=pl.col("Description").str.strip_chars(),
        amount=amount_expr,
        balance=balance_clean,
        reference=pl.col("Ref No").str.strip_chars(),
    )
